title: AI-Mediated Discipline in Scientific Ideation: A Transcript-Based Analysis of Hypothesis Generation in Mitochondrial Transport Studies

contributions.purpose: 论证 AI 中介的核心价值在于约束/纪律而非扩量
contributions.mechanism: 对 4 场角色化(PI/Method Architect/Critical Reviewer)虚拟实验室转录做定性编码分析(假设/批评/精化/决策四类)
contributions.evaluation: 定性研究:双轮编码一致率 94%;无定量基准/统计检验(checklist Q7 自认 N/A)
contributions.domain: AI 辅助科学发现 / 假设生成
contributions.source_quote: the primary contribution of AI mediation lies in its ability to structure ideation through precommitment, adversarialization, and transparent ledgering-thereby yielding robust, information-dense advances.

contributions.purpose: 提炼 AI 中介施加纪律的三机制
contributions.mechanism: 转录证据归纳:预承诺可观测量/基线/阈值、批评转化为消融/验证门、决策 ledger 化
contributions.evaluation: 以 MFN2(推进)、rotenone/RHOT1(因 proxy 不稳暂缓)、TRAK1(受复制门控)的跨假设对比佐证;纯结构化摘要非统计主张
contributions.source_quote: Three mechanisms structured this discipline. First, hypotheses were precommitted to observables, baselines, and thresholds... Second, critiques were systematically converted into operational ablations or validation gates... Third, convergence was ledgered.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Extending the Zou-group's open-source framework, this system introduced a novel approach to hypothesis generation that disciplined idea formation through explicit observables, comparators, and acceptance criteria [1].
The system, adapted from the Zou group's open-source repository and extended here for mitochondrial transport studies, is intentionally architectural (MIT License, commit from February 2025).

notes: 非实证/定性研究,分析对象仅为作者自建虚拟实验室生成的 4 场 GPT-5 转录(循环自证倾向:结论来自自己生成的对话,无外部湿实验验证,作者也明确声明只谈 ideation 过程不谈生物真值)。适配问题:四元组的 evaluation 无数字属正常(定性)。checklist 红旗:用的是 NeurIPS Paper Checklist 而非会议要求的 Agents4Science 专用 checklist(会议规定缺 checklist desk-reject),这很可能是 desk-reject 主因;文中含 Declaration of LLM usage 但格式不符。作者自曝 Goodhart 压力/过度约束风险。明确自认基于 Zou-group virtual-lab 扩展(provenance 已记)。与 desk-reject 一致。
